citation.title: Cardiac biomarker kinetics after exercise to exhaustion in normoxia and normobaric hypoxia in trained and untrained men

reported.what: Normoxia arm: graded cycle test to exhaustion (90 W, +30 W every 3 min), 10 min active rest, then a constant-workload test at the lactate-threshold workload to exhaustion; the workload in watts, the VO2 of the constant test and the durations of the tests are not printed (only the group VO2max, 64.2 and 44.1 mL/kg/min, and a total work of both tests in kJ)

location.quote: Exercise began at a workload of 90 W, with increments of 30 W every three minutes until volitional exhaustion.

reported.what: Heart rate at the end of exercise to exhaustion in normoxia, trained and untrained men (mean ± SD, n=12 each)
Change in blood lactate in response to the exercise in normoxia, trained and untrained men (mean ± SD, n=12 each)

detail: The bout that the post-exercise numbers follow is set at the group's lactate-threshold workload, which the paper does not print in watts or as oxygen uptake, so no activity level can be derived; the other numbers (cardiac biomarkers at rest, 2 h after a light meal and after 20 min in the chamber) are for markers the model does not carry, and the paper prints no resting heart rate, lactate or other model-marker values.
